scope: exact train40 plus validation5 CADs, one canonical ver input geometry perCAD

data_members.deck: GRID coordinates and actual interface/input metadata, never FEM solution fields

channel_order: four actual support RBE2 member sets sorted by master_node_id, then actual loaded interface member set; retain source card type
distance_units: dimensionless: physical mm distance / existing perCAD isotropic characteristic_length_mm
euclidean: nearest distance to SAME real interface member set, not master reference position
graph: multi-source min-only Dijkstra on unique undirected12 corner-mid subedges/TETRA10, no RBE shortcut/clique/diagonal edges
failure_policy: Record blocked CAD and whole manifest complete=false for ambiguous/unmapped sources or nonfinite/unreachable distances. No fill, clipping, source substitution, or downloads.
reuse_policy: Exact plan/source/split/input identities required; reuse completed CAD files with matching recorded identity, prepare only missingCADs. Preserve interrupted/blocked artifacts.
primary_pair_intent: Parent selected Euclidean-vsgraph with same additional5 channel layout, not zero-vsgraph; future model/training authorization separate.
limits: These are mesh-dependent input distances, not exact continuous geodesics, stiffness or an elasticity solver. Data readiness is not evidence of predictive gain/generalization.
